description:
Export the currently loaded 'ne_110m_admin_0_countries' layer to a KML file.

gvSIG Desktop is already open with the Natural Earth countries layer loaded. Your task:

1. Locate the 'ne_110m_admin_0_countries' layer in the Table of Contents (left panel).
2. Use the export functionality (e.g., Layer > Export to... or right-click context menu) to export this layer.
3. Select 'KML' (Keyhole Markup Language) as the output format.
4. Save the file to exactly: /home/ga/gvsig_data/exports/world_countries.kml
5. Ensure all features are exported.

The task is complete when the valid KML file exists at the specified path.
